home.faq.text: Install, send audio to OBS and sing with friends. Follow the steps with pictures.
home.faq.a1: No. An account helps you manage links, your profile and appearance settings across computers.
home.faq.q2: If my internet drops, do viewers still hear me?
home.faq.a2: Yes. DAW-to-OBS audio stays on your computer. Sharing links and singing with friends need internet.
home.faq.q3: How much delay does it add?
home.faq.a3: About one round of audio processing in your DAW. Check the actual delay next to the OBS status in the Hub.
home.faq.q4: Which DAWs does it work with?
home.faq.a4: Windows DAWs that support VST3, including Studio One, Cubase, Reaper, FL Studio and Ableton Live.
dl.winText: Install Hub, Track, App Audio and the audio source for OBS in one go.

dl.macText: A macOS version is not available yet.
dl.step1: Close your DAW and OBS, then run the installer
dl.step1sub: Windows may request administrator permission. Check the file source before allowing installation.
dl.step2sub: Put Hub on the main output (Master), and Track last on each track.
dl.step3: In OBS, add a source called HEARASIDE
dl.step3sub: The Hub connects by itself. The first time, Windows may ask to let your DAW through the firewall.
dl.need1: Music software (DAW) that supports VST3 plug-ins
dl.included: Includes cloudflared to let friends join over the internet
